summary: Phase A auth re-verification after `_client_ip` XFF helper landed — FULLY PASSING. All 21 pytest cases in test_phase_a_auth.py return green (up from 20/21 last iter). Rate-limit contract now holds cluster-wide: with a stable X-Forwarded-For the 9th wrong login → 429, and 6th wrong dev-login → 429. With a different XFF the same request gets its own fresh bucket (404). The `_client_ip` helper (server.py:703-712) is correctly implemented — reads left-most XFF entry, falls back to X-Real-IP, then request.client.host. No regressions: signup/login/verify/forgot/reset all return expected codes. Test file updated so each test carries a unique synthetic XFF header so tests do NOT share a single 10/hr signup bucket in Mongo (previously two tests failed because the whole suite fired >10 signups from the tester's real client IP and legitimately hit the cluster-wide cap).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:703-712 — `_client_ip` correctly implements XFF (left-most) → X-Real-IP → request.client.host fallback chain. Left-most XFF strip preserves the true origin behind the ingress.

server.py:768, 800, 914, 939, 968 — all five security-critical endpoints (dev-login / signup / resend / login / forgot) now derive their rate-limit key via `_client_ip(request)` instead of raw `request.client.host`. Verified via 6× dev-login reproducer: identical XFF → 5×404 then 429; different XFF → new bucket returns 404.

server.py:1984 — one remaining `request.client.host if request.client else None` usage in an OAuth session store (not a rate-limit key, so not a security issue). Optional cleanup: route it through `_client_ip(request)` for consistency.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_phase_a_auth.py — added `_fake_ip()` helper; each `api` fixture invocation now stamps a unique X-Forwarded-For so tests do not share the 10/hr per-IP signup bucket. `TestRateLimit.test_login_rate_limit` uses its own stable XFF so all 9 attempts land in the same bucket regardless of ingress path.
seed_data_creation: ~10 TEST_-prefixed user rows created by the pytest run (safe; cleanup regex `^TEST_`). db.rate_limit rows will TTL-expire.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://jobsite-assistant.preview.emergentagent.com. Dev secret in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Regression cmd: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=jp_handyman ANDY_DEV_SECRET=<...> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase_a_auth.py -v`. The test file already stamps a unique XFF per test so cross-test bucket collisions are impossible; only same-suite reruns within the same 5-minute window on the SAME synthetic XFF would collide (they won't, uuid4-based).
